question: Which state signed MoUs worth ₹38,750 crore at the World Economic Forum in Davos?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra signed MoUs worth ₹38,750 crore at the World Economic Forum in Davos.**
 
• The agreements include investments in defense, steel, electric vehicles (EVs), and metals.
 
• Key investors include Kalyani Group, Reliance Infrastructure, and Balasore Alloys.
 
• The investments are projected to create nearly 10,000 jobs in Maharashtra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra signed MoUs worth ₹38,750 crore during the World Economic Forum in Davos.**
 
• The Kalyani Group will invest ₹5,250 crore in defense, steel, and EVs, creating 4,000 jobs.
 
• Reliance Infrastructure committed ₹16,500 crore for defense, generating 2,450 jobs.
 
• Balasore Alloys pledged ₹17,000 crore for steel and metals, leading to 3,200 job opportunities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• World Economic Forum (WEF)__

 __
 
• An international organization for public-private cooperation, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.
 
• The annual meeting in Davos brings together global leaders, policymakers, and business executives to discuss economic and social challenges.
 
 
 
• Kalyani Group__
 __
 
• A prominent Indian conglomerate with operations in defense, engineering, and steel.
 
• The group’s investment focuses on modernizing defense production and promoting sustainability in steel and EV manufacturing.
 
 
 
• Balasore Alloys__
 
 
• A key player in the Indian steel and alloys sector.
 
• Their investment aims to enhance India’s steel production capacity and generate employment.
